name: Cube-4/VolumePro
definition: A cost-effective single board implementation of Cube-4 by Mitsubishi Electric, capable of 30Hz rendering of datasets with full Phong shading and interactive classification. It delivers 500 million shaded volume samples per second.
summary: Cube-4/VolumePro is a dedicated hardware architecture for real-time volume rendering that uses fixed-point arithmetic and Newton-Raphson gradient approximation to deliver 500 million shaded samples per second.
